requirement: Uppercase letters A-Z must now be shifted too, by the same k and wrapping from Z to A, and they stay uppercase (so "Zz" shifted by 1 is "Aa"). Lowercase letters behave as before, and all other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation, non-ASCII letters) are still unchanged.
desc: Shift every letter a-z and A-Z in s forward by k positions in the alphabet, wrapping around from z to a (and from Z to A); a letter keeps its case. k may be negative (shift backward) and may be larger than 26 in either direction. Every other character (digits, spaces, punctuation, non-ASCII letters) is unchanged.
